Install this APK as an update to LBS Interior Studio 0.1.0 to keep projects saved on this phone. It uses the same package name and preview signing certificate.

Open **Projects**, choose a saved design and tap **View in room**. **Live camera** lets you show the design over the phone camera, and **Freeze view** holds the room background. You can also select **Choose room photo**. Tap to position the wardrobe, adjust its apparent size, turn it and show its interior.

Camera and photo placement are approximate. **Full-size AR** uses floor tracking on supported devices. This update also retries temporary ARCore availability checks and gives the native camera view a fixed display area.
